profile.headline: Software Engineer at Mutual of Omaha

positions.title: Application Solution Architect
positions.description: Lead developer for the Okta migration team. Migrated a multi-billion dollar payment platform from an in-house Oauth2 identity provider to the Okta Identity Cloud.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for the management, strategy and execution of IT infrastructure for the organization. Sole application developer for all applications used by the organization to run daily operations.

Managed an IT staff of 6 people responsible for Help Desk, computer workstations, networking, office & cell phones and printers. 

Custom applications project sheet attached. Percentage of time spent on development & implementation - 80%.

positions.title: Software Solutions Architect
positions.description:
Specialized in WebSphere Portal administration & development.

Projects:
1. Lead Architect of Sales Quoting System for a large Midwestern insurance company written entirely within WebSphere Portal using Spring Portlet, Hibernate and Dojo Toolkit running against a DB2 backend.
2. Senior developer responsible for writing a web-based front end connecting to a Web Services backend for a large Midwestern financial institution. technologies utilized - Spring, Spring Web Services.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Senior Consultant focused on converting over 20 large & medium sized Lotus Notes applications to Java-based web applications. Technologies used:
1. Struts, Spring MVC

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Lotus Notes Development, Lotus Notes Administration. Lead developer in department's Lotus Notes group.

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.description: Senior level developer within the Lotus Notes Practice.

positions.title: Deputy Sheriff
positions.description: Deputy II within the Sheriff's Office.
